new_destinations.name: Mount Putuo
new_destinations.name_evidence: Wikivoyage has a Putuoshan page (and Zhoushan page listing it); Buddhist sacred island, one of four sacred Buddhist mountains of China, national park.
new_destinations.reason: Six kept spots on the island itself (Puji, South Sea Guanyin, Fayu, Huiji, Foding Mountain, Hundred Step Beach), above the four-spot bar; rank 3 honestly, a famous pilgrimage island but not a top-two country highlight. Span 15 km covers the 8.6 km island. Zhoushan is not proposed as a region destination: the islands are separate ferry bases spread over ~150 km, so a region span would balloon.

placements.name: Puji Temple
placements.coordinates_source: Wikivoyage Putuoshan listing geotag (Wikipedia point 1.3 km north-west)
placements.bio_draft: the island's main monastery, with a dawn monks' ritual
placements.skeptic_objection: Crowded and one of ~80 temples; but it is one of the three famous ones.
placements.reason: Inside Mount Putuo island bounds (about 8.6 km long) and within its span. Pin from Wikivoyage listing geotag.

placements.name: South Sea Guanyin
placements.coordinates_source: OSM Nominatim: OSM artwork Guanyin of the South Sea
placements.bio_draft: 33 m bronze Guanyin statue in a stone plaza at the island's south end
placements.skeptic_objection: A statue is a short visit; but it is the island's headline sight.
placements.reason: Inside Mount Putuo island bounds (about 8.6 km long) and within its span. Pin from OSM artwork.

placements.name: Fayu Temple
placements.bio_draft: temple of layered halls with a Nine-Dragon ceiling, one of the three great monasteries
placements.skeptic_objection: Another temple; only the three famous ones are singled out, and this is one.
placements.reason: Inside Mount Putuo island bounds (about 8.6 km long) and within its span.

placements.name: Huiji Temple
placements.coordinates_source: Wikivoyage Putuoshan listing geotag (Wikipedia point about 1 km north-east)
placements.bio_draft: temple near the top of Foding Mountain, reached by cable car or a step climb
placements.skeptic_objection: Overlaps the Foding Mountain hike; kept as the temple, the hike is judged separately.
placements.reason: Inside Mount Putuo island bounds (about 8.6 km long) and within its span.

placements.name: Foding Mountain
placements.coordinates_source: Wikivoyage Putuoshan listing geotag (Foding Shan listing)
placements.bio_draft: the island's highest hill, with a step climb to Huiji Temple and sea views
placements.skeptic_objection: Summit is a closed radar site and Huiji Temple sits on it, so it can read as part of Huiji.
placements.reason: Inside Mount Putuo island bounds (about 8.6 km long) and within its span. Summit is a closed radar site; pin is the Wikivoyage listing geotag.

placements.name: Hundred Step Beach
placements.bio_draft: sand beach beside the hotels with lockers, showers and chair hire
placements.skeptic_objection: One source; ordinary sand beach beside hotels.
placements.reason: Inside Mount Putuo island bounds (about 8.6 km long) and within its span. Beach pin must come from OSM natural/beach, not a Wikivoyage listing geotag.

placements.name: Luojia Shan
placements.coordinates_source: OSM Nominatim: OSM island Luojia Shan
placements.bio_draft: small ferry island off Putuo with monasteries, a pagoda and a lighthouse
placements.skeptic_objection: Needs a CNY70 ferry with a fixed 2 h window; the place itself is the spot, its pagoda/monasteries are not separate spots.
placements.reason: Standalone: a separate island about 5 km east of Mount Putuo reached by ferry, outside Putuo island bounds.

placements.name: Shenjiamen Fishing Port
placements.coordinates_source: Wikivoyage Zhoushan listing geotag (Shenjiamen Fishing Port listing)
placements.bio_draft: working harbour known for its evening seafood stalls
placements.skeptic_objection: Mostly an evening meal stop.
placements.reason: Standalone: port town on the Zhoushan main island side, outside Mount Putuo island bounds (about 10 km from it by sea).

placements.name: Nansha Beach
placements.bio_draft: long mountain-backed beach on Zhujiajian with roped swimming areas
placements.skeptic_objection: Entry fee and busy in summer.
placements.reason: Standalone: Zhujiajian is a separate island from Putuo; with Dongsha Beach and Wushitang only three kept places there, below the four-spot bar.

placements.name: Dongsha Beach
placements.bio_draft: quieter scenic beach next to Nansha on Zhujiajian
placements.skeptic_objection: Next to Nansha; swimming is forbidden per China Daily, but a distinct beach.
placements.reason: Standalone: Zhujiajian island, three kept places only.

placements.name: Wushitang
placements.bio_draft: black-pebble beach bay on Zhujiajian known for its cobblestones
placements.skeptic_objection: Ticket about CNY30, slippery stones; second-tier beach.
placements.reason: Standalone: Zhujiajian island, three kept places only.

placements.name: Dongsha Ancient Town
placements.bio_draft: old fishing town of lanes and courtyard houses on Daishan Island
placements.skeptic_objection: Single government-tourism source; ancient-town claims may be exaggerated.
placements.reason: Standalone: on Daishan Island (not Zhujiajian); Daishan has only three kept places (with Lulan Qingsha, Moxin Mountain). Candidate pin was a loose name match: re-resolve.

placements.name: Lulan Qingsha
placements.bio_draft: 3.6 km sand beach on Daishan Island, paid entry
placements.skeptic_objection: Paid entry.
placements.reason: Standalone: Daishan Island, three kept places only.

placements.name: Moxin Mountain
placements.bio_draft: Daishan's highest peak with Ciyun temple and sea views
placements.skeptic_objection: Local mountain.
placements.reason: Standalone: Daishan Island, three kept places only.

placements.name: Gouqi Island
placements.bio_draft: wolfberry island of fishing harbour, painted villages and sunrise and sunset viewpoints
placements.skeptic_objection: An island-area; its sub-listings (church, sunrise) are folded in.
placements.reason: Standalone: Shengsi archipelago, about 85 km from Putuo; separate island group with three kept places (Gouqi, Jihu Beach, Houtouwan), below the four-spot bar.

placements.name: Jihu Beach
placements.bio_draft: main beach of Sijiao island with surfing and jet skis
placements.skeptic_objection: Sources are commercial; no counted-source page confirmed.
placements.reason: Standalone: Shengsi archipelago, three kept places only.

placements.name: Houtouwan Village
placements.bio_draft: abandoned fishing village on Shengshan island swallowed by ivy
placements.skeptic_objection: Remote; ferry hassle; access rules change.
placements.reason: Standalone: Shengsi archipelago, three kept places only.

placements.name: Taohua Island
placements.bio_draft: Peach Blossom Island, Condor Heroes filming location with beaches and a botanical valley
placements.skeptic_objection: Some attractions are paid and themed.
placements.reason: Standalone: separate island about 30 km south-east of Mount Putuo; its sub-sights (Anqi Peak, theme park) are under review.

placements.name: Dongji
placements.bio_draft: the East Pole islands with a sunrise lookout, fishing villages and a film location
placements.skeptic_objection: Area covering its sub-spots; ferry-dependent.
placements.reason: Standalone: remote island group about 45 km east of Putuo. Township point is not an island point: re-resolve.

placements.name: Dongfu Mountain
placements.bio_draft: lookout on Dongji named as the first sunrise over the sea in China
placements.skeptic_objection: Early start; part of Dongji.
placements.reason: Standalone: on Dongji; two kept places in the group, so no destination. Verify it is a distinct draw from Dongji when pinned.

review.name: Thousand Step Beach
review.judge_reason: Rule 1: Wikivoyage names a longer quiet beach. For: second-tier beach a guide names. Against: no facilities and signs forbid swimming.
review.objection: Single source, no swimming; a walk-on-sand stop only.

review.name: Chaoyin Cave
review.judge_reason: Rule 1+3: Wikivoyage lists carved sea cliffs; guides place the sea cave in the Zijuzhu area with Bukenqu. For: free, short coastal stop. Against: small, may belong with Bukenqu/Zijuzhu.
review.objection: Near-duplicate of the Bukenqu area; short visit.

review.name: Fanyin Cave
review.judge_reason: Rule 1: Wikivoyage names Shancai/Fanyin Cave on the east coast (bus from Fayu, then forest walk); a guide route lists it on day 2. For: second-tier coastal sight. Against: one source, a small cave.
review.objection: Short stop; mainly a way to reach the quiet east coast.

review.name: Northern Village
review.judge_reason: Rule 1: Wikivoyage names a partly abandoned historic village with footpaths. For: quirky off-path sight. Against: single source, needs a hike, partly a military training area.

review.name: Bukenqu Temple
review.judge_reason: Rule 1+2: Wikivoyage names it as the Luojia Shan viewpoint; guides call it the island's ancestral Guanyin temple in the Zijuzhu (Purple Bamboo) area. For: named visitor stop. Against: wording of the source is only a viewpoint; overlap with Chaoyin Cave.
review.objection: Possibly one outing with Chaoyin Cave.

review.judge_reason: Rule 1: only Ctrip; location unconfirmed and no counted source found in a fresh search. For: Ctrip top-sight list. Against: cannot verify what or where it is.

near_destination_standalone_note: Within about 40 km of Mount Putuo (centre 30.010,122.385): Luojia Shan, Shenjiamen Fishing Port, Nansha Beach, Dongsha Beach, Wushitang, Taohua Island lie on other islands, outside its island bounds (and most beyond its 11 km reach); a ferry journey is not bounds.
